The sign-in tickets are read before the account's turn and not re-checked inside it, so parallel requests on one ticket can open two sessions or re-confirm a set-up; submitSetup also reads the enrolled state before the turn

Any successful sign-in clears the client's failure record, and requests with a valid session skip the unauthenticated bucket, so an account holder can launder the per-client throttle while spraying other accounts.
